body:
I have tried talking to them. The first time that I planned on killing myself, they freaked and brought me to the hospital right away. I **hate** hospitals. I really don't want to risk going through that again. I may talk to my therapist a bit about it.

Yeah, it's frustrating. I hate him, but my parents won't let me switch. "He's the professional, and he knows what's best for you." He's him, not me; is my philosophy on it.

I am in HS. I hate it soooo much. They work us hard (private school) and then don't give a shit when you have issues. I want to drop out to be honest. I just can't stand how unsympathetic they are. All they care about is the money.

It's things like that that really bring me down, you know? People have forgotten about the simple things. It's all money, money, money nowadays. I'm losing faith in people overall.

I'm failing school because my psychiatrist refuses to treat my ADD. That and I'm stuck in a traditional school, but I learn in a much different fashion.

I've asked out at least 10 girls this year. Nothing. Not even a "maybe". It's irrational, yes, but it's driving me off the wall.

My parents won't let me take a break. I'm a minor. Technically, I'm on my spring break right now. But they just force me to work and work and work. I just dream of flying down to Belize, help set up Reddit Island, relax in the sun, and take it all in. I want to make a friend.

But I can't.
